description: An item can be a piece of content like an article. A good list of items follows a common theme.

name: maxItems
label: Max. items
description: A maximum is a limit on the number of items shown. A good limit includes enough items but not so many that users need to scroll.

name: fieldDelimiter
label: Field delimiter
description: A field delimiter is a character that separates each field from the next one for readability. A good delimiter is clear but unobtrusive.

name: noContentMessage
label: No content message
description: This message shows when there’s no content. A good message is simple and helps users move on, like ”No content yet”.

name: noContentSecondaryText
label: No content secondary message
description: This message adds more details to the ”no content message”. Good details include practical steps users can follow.

name: showWhenContentIsAvailable
label: Show when content is available
description: Show related content to users only when there's content available for them.
